scenes.summary: You meet Carly at Fangxing Avenue. She is telling stories to the local children. You talk to Carly and find out that she wants to draw a new storybook based on your adventures in the region of Wuling.

lines.text: And finally, the heroes found Princess Carly in the Evil Caster's castle. It turns out that Princess Carly was...
I guess Princess Carly misses her Knights of the Sky.
Ah! Endmin! Haha! The Endmin's here!
...like how clouds miss their raindrops, or how trees miss the fowls! That's how much I miss you, Endmin!
And Grampa Gatekeeper, my friends, the grownups, the big boys and girls... We all miss you, Endmin!
The residents of the Worker Dorms haven't seen you for a while, Endmin. Everyone misses you!
That's why I got a ride in a caravan with the grownups so I can come to Wuling City! Everyone agreed, you know!
A Tianshi at the Worker Dorms told me that you must be busy saving the world at Wuling. So, I decided to come here, meet the Endmin, and draw a new adventure.
Once the new storybook is complete, I can share it with anyone who misses the Endmin!
Yeah. Princess Carly will join the Knights of the Sky, and defeat the Evil Caster! AGAIN!
Heheh! Is it 'cos of this new outfit?
The grownups chose it for me. They say I will look super, duper, ultra — PRETTY wearing it!
Watchu think, Endmin?
Very choice. You look just like a nice kid from Wuling.
That's what my friends here tell me too!
You're amazing, Princess Carly.
Heheh. That's what the grownups say too!
Oh yeah, I wanted to see because I need your help, Endmin!
And hello there, Endmin!
I haven't seen you for a while, Endmin. I really miss you, just like ... like...
Tell me.

options: Why are you in Wuling, Carly?
A new adventure for Princess Carly and the Sky Knights?
We'll defeat the Evil Caster once more!

lines.text: Yeah! I exchanged my storybook with my friends here.
Their storybooks have such pretty drawings. So I learned the technique for my new storybook.

options: Learned it? By just seeing it?

lines.text: Thank you for helping me draw my storybook!

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done

lines.text: While sitting in the caravan to Wuling, the grownups told me stories about the place!
They told me that Wuling is a place with mountains and flowing rivers! It's TOTALLY different compared to Valley IV.
After arriving at Wuling, I discovered that it's the truth! It's nothing like Valley IV! It's also a new place where the Endmin started a new adventure.
So I decided to share the natural beauty of Wuling and your new adventure with everyone in the Worker Dorms, Endmin!

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: Grampa Gatekeeper told me all about it, Endmin. He told me that the grownups and our big friends from Endfield are fighting to protect us!
The forest of stone pillars outside Wuling also defeated many monsters. I think they're just like the Endmin and Endfielders —
This means they're super powerful knights who defend everyone! They are also as pure as the little creeks of Wuling!

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: I can tell that Tangtang is a very nice person. Everyone from Qingbo Stockade is very nice too...
But why don't they like Wuling City? It's so beautiful.
My friends at Wuling are also very nice. Oh yes, they even gave me a super round chubby lung!
So after I heard about the Endmin's adventures, I was thinking if something really bad happened...
...something super terrible that made Wuling and Qingbo dislike each other?

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: Hehe! You're super duper smart, Endmin! Me and my friends wanna be as smart as you!
So I wanna draw the place where all the smart grownups are. I'm gonna tell my friends that getting knowledge will make us as smart as the Endmin!
If only I could have a Knowledge Butterfly! It'll make me smart like the Endmin, and then I'll know everything!

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: Heheh. That's Zhuang Fangyi, Endmin. She is definitely super incredible and beautiful too!
My friends in Wuling told me that you helped Miss Zhuang, just like how you helped Valley IV!
That's why I wanna draw it so people know that the Endmin is just helping people in another place! You are always with us!

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: The LB baddies are so evil! They're trying to break things everywhere!
They broke Carly's home at Valley IV. And now they're also hurting the people in Qingbo Stockade.
So I wanna draw it. The Knights of the Sky teaching the naughty big bad who also hurt us before.

w: Once “Help Carly complete her storybook” is done
Before that

lines.text: Awesome. You defeated the naughty big bad again!
But Biggie Ruan ... I heard about his story with Tangtang and it made me really sad.
So I think that in my story, after Biggie Ruan got defeated, he became a cloud in the sky.
And then he turned into rain that fell, and came back to us once more.

lines.text: And so, Watergirl returned to the Knights of the Sky and Princess Carly...
ALRIGHTY! The storybook is done!
Anyone who reads it will fall in love with the story!
I really wanna show my storybook to all of my friends!
But I don't wanna leave you again, Endmin...
Yeah. The adventure continues! The Knights and the Princess will visit even more places!
Although the Evil Caster's plot failed, other big mean baddies will try to do more evil.
Princess Carly must return to her castle and ready her entourage for the next adventure!
And once all the big meanies are defeated, the Knights of the Sky must return and present themselves to Princess Carly!
I really wanna make more storybooks, but I'm out of drawing paper...
Once I start a new storybook, I'll definitely let you know!
Oh, yeah, Endmin, this is for you!
Heheh. The grownups who came to pick us up asked me to give this to you, Endmin.
Uncle Roman made it. Fabian, Aleeza, Shawna, and Molly helped too. Lemme think who else...
It's like ... a whole lot of people...! Let's just say everyone helped! So take a bite, Endmin!
